title: BenchmarkTask
description: One benchmark task definition. Frozen by .omo/plans/dsh-code-index-0.6-p0-1-design.md section 5. A task is instantiated per seed to form a matched task-seed block.

id.description: Stable task id, unique across bench/tasks/**.

category.description: Task family. The pilot should balance lookup, architecture, test, bug-fix, and feature work so it is not structurally biased toward one tool.

commit.description: Full 40-hex commit SHA. Immutable: the pilot never tracks a branch.

subdir.description: Optional monorepo subdirectory that becomes the working root.

prompt.description: Task instruction handed to the agent, verbatim.

setup.description: Optional preparation applied after checkout and before the agent runs.

patch.description: Path (relative to the task file) or inline unified diff applied with `git apply`.

commands.description: Shell commands run in the workdir after checkout.

judge.description: Deterministic pass/fail judging. Every command must exit 0 for the run to succeed.

commands.description: Shell commands executed in the workdir via `sh -c`. Exit 0 = pass.

requiredFiles.description: Repo-relative paths that must exist after the run.

forbiddenFiles.description: Repo-relative paths that must NOT exist after the run.

expectedSymbols.description: Symbols the task is about; recorded for reporting, not scored.

expectedTests.description: Test files a correct impact analysis must surface; recorded, not scored directly.

exclusions.description: Documented reasons a run of this task may be excluded from aggregation (e.g. flaky network).
